description: Create a time-off request for a user (default the calling user). It starts pending; cancel it with wheniwork_update_time_off_request (status 1). Get type ids from wheniwork_list_time_off_types. When I Work: POST /2/requests.

end_time.description: End of the time off, full date-time.

hours.description: Hours of paid time off to use.

paid.description: Whether it is paid time off.

start_time.description: Start of the time off, full date-time.

user_id.description: Who is taking time off (default the calling user).

name: wheniwork_create_time_off_request
title: Create a time-off request
